name: Popover
summary: A floating surface anchored to a trigger, holding any content up to and including buttons and inputs, opened by click and closed by a click outside or Escape. Use it where a tooltip is too small or non-interactive; use a menu for a list of commands, a dialog for something modal, and a teaching popover for onboarding.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: A PopoverTrigger wrapping one element and a PopoverSurface holding the content; the surface alone when a custom target positions it.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Controls visibility; onOpenChange reports every request to change it.

inputs.name: onOpenChange
inputs.description: Runs with the new open value on trigger click, outside click, Escape, hover, context menu or scroll.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: normal is the theme's surface; brand the brand background with on-brand text; inverted the static dark background with white text.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Padding 12, 16 or 20px and the arrow's height, 6px at small and 8px otherwise.

inputs.name: withArrow
inputs.description: Draws an arrow on the surface pointing at the trigger.

inputs.name: positioning
inputs.description: Where the surface sits relative to its trigger; the full positioning shorthand also takes an alignment and flips to stay in the viewport.

inputs.name: openOnHover
inputs.description: Opens on pointer enter and closes on pointer leave after mouseLeaveDelay.

inputs.name: mouseLeaveDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before a hover-opened popover closes.

inputs.name: openOnContext
inputs.description: Opens on the context-menu event at the pointer, anchored to the click point, and disables the other triggers.

inputs.name: closeOnScroll
inputs.description: Closes when the page scrolls outside the surface; context popovers always do.

inputs.name: trapFocus
inputs.description: Traps Tab inside the surface and marks it a dialog; inertTrapFocus makes the rest of the page inert instead.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: Renders the surface in DOM order rather than in a portal on the body.

anatomy.name: PopoverTrigger
anatomy.description: Wraps one element, making it an ARIA button that toggles the popover and reports aria-expanded.

anatomy.name: PopoverSurface
anatomy.description: The floating box: appearance colours, body1 text, borderRadiusMedium, a 1px transparent border, the size's padding and two drop shadows.

anatomy.name: Arrow
anatomy.description: A rotated square behind the surface's edge in the surface's colour, pointing at the trigger.

variants.description: The static dark background with static inverted text in every theme.

layout.text: The surface is a block with borderRadiusMedium corners, a 1px colorTransparentStroke border and body1 text; its padding is 12, 16 or 20px by size.
Two drop shadows through a filter, so the arrow is shadowed too: 0 0 2px in colorNeutralShadowAmbient then 0 8px 16px in colorNeutralShadowKey, shadow16's geometry written out.

With withArrow the arrow is 6px high at small and 8px at medium and large, and the surface is offset from the trigger by that height; the positioning engine is told the surface's corner radius is 4 so the arrow clears the rounded corner.
An inline surface is absolutely positioned at z-index 1 so relatively positioned siblings such as inputs do not cover it.
The surface is positioned above its trigger by default and flips or shifts to stay in the viewport; it is rendered in a portal unless inline.

states.text: Opening fades the surface in while it slides 10px from the side it is positioned on, over durationSlower with curveDecelerateMid; closing unmounts it at once.
The appearance's colours; the surface has no hover, pressed or focus look of its own, and content inside draws its own focus indicators.
The trigger reports aria-expanded while the popover is open and keeps its own look.

behaviour.text: A click on the trigger, or Enter or Space on it, toggles the popover; onOpenChange reports the request.
A click or focus outside the trigger and surface closes it, as does Escape; with trapFocus only a genuine focus move from inside to outside counts.
With openOnHover the trigger's pointer enter opens and pointer leave closes after mouseLeaveDelay (500ms unless set).
With openOnContext the context-menu event opens the popover anchored to the pointer's position and other triggers are disabled; it closes on scroll.
With closeOnScroll (or openOnContext) scrolling outside the surface closes it.
Opening moves focus to the first focusable element in the surface unless disabled; with trapFocus Tab cycles inside the surface.
The enter motion is fade plus a 10px slide from the positioned side over durationSlower with curveDecelerateMid; there is no exit motion.

keyboard: Enter or Space on the trigger opens and closes it
Tab moves through the surface's content, cycling inside it with trapFocus
semantics: the trigger is an ARIA button with aria-expanded
the surface is a group, or a dialog when trapFocus is set
focus moves into the surface on open and back to the trigger on close

notes.text: The 12, 16 and 20px paddings, the 1px border, the drop-shadow geometry, the 6 and 8px arrow heights and the surface radius the positioning engine is given (4, borderRadiusMedium's value) are constants in the styles file and constants.ts; the 10px slide and the 500ms mouse-leave delay are constants in the motion and hook files.
The shadow is a filter drop-shadow following the arrow's outline, written out because there is no filter form of shadow16; a box shadow on the rectangle leaves the arrow unshadowed.
The inverted appearance reads the Static tokens, which do not change between light and dark themes.
No forced-colors rule of its own; the 1px colorTransparentStroke border becomes visible under the high-contrast theme and outlines the surface while the shadow vanishes.
